footnotes.fn_dc879acb: In 2023, UNHCR conducted an extensive identification exercise of stateless persons in Azerbaijan using both government and UNHCR registers. The exercise was able to account for 513 stateless person, which was used as the start year figure. During 2024, 306 individuals at risk of statelessness were able to acquire citizenship. Additional persons of undetermined nationality were identified during the year, resulting in a total of 271 stateless persons in the country at end-year based on information from the State Migration Service, the Ministry of Internal Affairs and UNHCR.
